product_launches.description: Postscript and Tie launched a new integration that uses Tie's identity graph to recognize opted-in SMS subscribers across devices and browsers and feed behavioral data into Postscript for expanded abandonment SMS automations.

overview_description.description: Postscript is an eCommerce SMS platform that enables brands to communicate and engage with customers through text message marketing. It allows users to easily create and manage SMS marketing campaigns with detailed analytics to improve sales and revenue. It plugs into eCommerce businesses and helps overcome declining email engagement by sending customers targeted and customizable SMS marketing.

product.name: Postscript SMS Marketing
product.description: A cloud-based SMS marketing platform for Shopify brands to grow subscriber lists, send campaigns and automations, segment audiences, and manage compliant customer messaging.

product.name: Postscript AI
product.description: AI-powered features for optimizing SMS campaigns and automations, generating message variants, and identifying incremental revenue and brand insights.

product.name: Postscript Shopper
product.description: An AI shopping assistant for SMS that answers subscriber questions and supports one-to-one conversations intended to drive ecommerce purchases.

product.name: Postscript Plus
product.description: A managed SMS marketing service in which Postscript strategists create, operate, and optimize a brand’s SMS program.

product.name: Postscript RCS
product.description: A rich messaging service that lets brands send enhanced messages from a branded profile to increase customer engagement and conversions.

product.name: Postscript CashBack
product.description: A coupon alternative that uses cashback incentives to support ecommerce conversions, subscriber list growth, and contribution-margin management.
